title: GL.iNET Puli (XE-300)
body:
Hi all,

first of all, thank you for this project. I own a GL.iNET Puli (XE-300) running OpenWRT and with a Quectel EG25-G PCI-E module inside. Is there any chance to get Rayhunter to work on this device? 

What tests can i perform to before starting the port to see if I have any chance of success?

Thanks

category.name: General
category.description: Chat about anything and everything here

comments.body: I'd read through the threads under the new-hardware tag to get an idea: https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/discussions?discussions_q=is%3Aopen+label%3Anew-hardware
